summary: Antares Strategic Credit Fund filed an 8-K covering Item 7.01 (Regulation FD) disclosing a $0.1847/share regular distribution payable July 30, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026, reinvestible via its distribution reinvestment plan. Item 8.01 (Other Events) reports it is offering common shares continuously in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506 and Regulation S; on June 1, 2026 it received ~$4.8 million in subscriptions. The filing also provides NAV per share ($24.97), aggregate NAV (~$2,201.1M), loan commitments (~$5,497.6M), and debt outstanding (~$2,380.1M, debt/equity 1.08x). This is a routine distribution and NAV update with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender, spin-off, or activist campaign; the continuous offering is a standard periodic capital raise. What to watch: continued monthly NAV disclosures and subscription flows.
